name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) plus Response(at_exit, holding_box) capture 'carry the box to the exit' (holding_box must be true when at_exit occurs), and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move'.

texts: Reach the exit holding the box.
Whenever the exit is reached, the box is held.
Whenever the box falls, the agent picks it up on the very next step.
